name: Atlanta Braves
notes: Revenue is the listed owner's Baseball segment for calendar 2025 ($635,060k in the 10-K table); group total incl. Mixed-Use Development was $732.5M. Stakes are % of aggregate VOTING power from the 2026 proxy table (economic % differs by series: e.g. GAMCO 31.2% of BATRA, 5.7% of BATRK); the table cells contain zero-width spaces, which the evidence strings omit. Operating result is Baseball Adjusted OIBDA (non-GAAP, close to EBITDA); group operating loss was $(13.5)M. Forbes (2026) values the team at $3.35B (rank #8) with revenue $524M and operating income $27M (its own basis, net of revenue sharing); the filing figures are used instead. The 10-K reports 26,633 average attendees per regular-season home game in 2025 (definition: ticketholders who enter) — not recorded as attendance because it is far below published paid attendance; check before use. Holdings' total debt $738.6M at 31 Dec 2025 includes Mixed-Use Development debt (not net). Socials not sourced.

ownership_summary: Owned by Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BATRA, BATRK), split off from Liberty Media on 18 July 2023. John C. Malone controls about 50.0% of the voting power (after a 5 February 2026 transaction); GAMCO Investors holds 16.0% of the vote, Vanguard 3.7% and BlackRock 2.9% (2026 proxy). Chairman, President and CEO Terence F. McGuirk votes Malone's Series B shares on routine matters under an August 2024 agreement.
